title: Identifying implicit bias in LLM-based chat AI toward people with intellectual disabilities

live_model.evidence: 'Utilizing the GPT-4-Turbo model, we requested story-generation based on 10 prompt stems' ... 'Temperature was set to 1.0 (the default), a seed was used' (Methods; run December 2024)

prompt.location: Methods (story prompts 'Tell me a short story about a person [with intellectual disabilities] [situation]' with the ten situations) and Appendix 1 (question prompt for story analysis)
prompt.note: System prompt 'Assistant is a large language model.'; 250 seeded stories per condition.

claim.metric: odds ratio of paternalistic tone, ID Present vs ID Absent stories (GPT-4-Turbo)
claim.location: Results, GPT-4-Turbo paragraph and Figure 2 (OR = 136.59 [105.88, 176.21]; infantilization OR = 407.43)

notes: Re-execution needs 5,000 generations plus 5,000 analysis calls per seed at temperature 1.0; the OR is computed from GPT-4-Turbo-coded categories.
